messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Earlier Message

Hi [Colleague's Name],

I’m sorry for my abrupt comment earlier; it was unprofessional and I regret any hurt it caused. I value our collaboration and will strive to communicate more thoughtfully moving forward. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to make amends.

Best,
[Your Name]

PLAN: Open your email client and create a new message.
PLAN: Fill in the subject line as “Apology for My Earlier Message”.
PLAN: Paste the drafted body, replace placeholders with names, and send.
